method.construction: Cold means cacheTranslation:false: fresh runtime instance, initialization, lowering, WASM module compilation and instance binding. Warm is a verified library translation-cache hit into fresh device memory. Runtime module import/compilation is excluded. V8 may internally cache identical compiled bytes even when the library cache is bypassed; this is not a cold process launch.
method.capture: Time only public capturePhysical calls on a fresh warm-constructed device, from reset through identical frame intervals. Includes translated CPU, C peripheral scheduling, physical pin integration, wrapper allocation/copy and initial audio configuration. These costs are coupled; CPU-only and peripheral-only wall times are unresolved without internal instrumentation.
method.dsp: Time only the production JS Renderer.processRaw calls on exactly those captured blocks. Includes filter/gain state, output allocation and JS sample-summary updates, with no CPU/peripheral execution. DSP construction is outside the timers.
method.correctness: Every trial compares all four configurations byte for byte for raw and filtered Float32 PCM, plus complete visible data/EEPROM/Flash and architectural/IRQ state at every block endpoint. Trial baselines are also compared across trials. The idleCycles performance counter is excluded from equality; the snapshots enumerate the selected architectural diagnostics. Hashing, signal summaries, snapshots and assertions are outside measured regions.
method.ordering: One unmeasured warmup per firmware/variant, then fresh devices for every run. Four-order Williams rotation across variants; cold/warm constructor order alternates with trial and run position. No forced GC or CPU affinity; V8 tiering, GC and other host load remain in samples.
method.limits: Node measurements are not browser guarantees. Samples start at reset and cover only the selected duration, not whole compositions. Exclusive CPU/peripheral timing, browser AudioWorklet overhead and host audio scheduling are not measured.
